text:
Alex P.: Q4 planning sync for Hosted API — need to pick top 3 initiatives across chat / completions / embeddings / rerank. Post blockers + must-have launch criteria by EOD.
Maya Chen: From GTM/customer side: top asks = streaming stability, lower p50 p99 for short chats, and faster bulk embeddings for search indexing. Customers pushing for function calling with stable streaming.
Isabella (Eng): Engineering constraints: current runtime can hit p50 ~40ms for short chats on smallest model, but p99 spikes on cold KV cache. To hit tighter p99 we need better cache priming + smarter batching.
Samir (Infra): Infra note — autoscaling warmup is the biggest source of p99 noise. We can add a small warm pool for hot routes, but that increases baseline cost ~5%. Need product signoff.
Jordan (Sales): A large marketplace customer will only go live if our embeddings throughput >= 800 req/s and a launch SLA for latency. They also asked about private deployment later — we should make Hosted roadmap clear.
Priya (CSE): Support signals: a few enterprise pilots complained about rerank API missing top-k deterministic ordering and inconsistent scores across versions. They want a simple stable rerank v1 before advanced rerank features.
Alex P.: Proposed top-3 for Q4: A) Chat: reduce p99 by 40% + streaming 99.9% availability B) Embeddings: bulk API with 1k req/s burst and deterministic batching C) Rerank v1: consistent scoring, top-k + simple explainability. Thoughts?
Isabella (Eng): Agree with ordering but suggest scope: Chat improvements = runtime + kernel selection + cache TTL tuning. Embeddings bulk needs batching + backpressure. Rerank v1 could be a lightweight wrapper around existing model + scoring hook.
Samir (Infra): If we add a warm pool for chat hot routes, we need an opt-in config per org to control cost. Suggest rollout plan: stage flag -> canary -> org opt-in -> wide.
Jordan (Sales): Rollout plan sounds good. For enterprise sales, we need clear launch criteria: numbers and docs. Can Product produce an internal launch checklist we can hand to customers?
Alex P.: Yes — draft launch criteria that we can iterate on. Initial checklist proposal: - p50/p99 targets (numeric) - streaming success rate >= 99.9% - embeddings throughput + bulk latency SLA - rerank deterministic top-k + regression tests - rollout plan + feature flag - cost impact estimate + mitigation (quantization / opt-in warm pool) - docs + migration guide
Maya Chen: Add evaluation criteria: run prompt set N=200 from top customers and compare generation quality before/after (no regressions >2% failure). Also include cost per 1k tokens target for Hosted baseline.
Priya (CSE): For rerank tests, include an offline evaluation harness and a small canary with real traffic for 48h and automated rollback on metric drift.
Isabella (Eng): Technical acceptance: provide perf dashboard panels (latency, cache hit rate, batching size distribution), smoke alerts, and a synthetic load harness for consistent benchmarking.
Samir (Infra): Ops acceptance: runbook + autoscaling thresholds + warm pool budget + rollback playbook. I'll draft runbook sections.
Alex P.: OKRs tie-in: our Q4 objective is "Increase Hosted API reliability & cost efficiency" Key results: 1) reduce chat inference cost per 1M tokens by 30% 2) p99 chat latency down 40% 3) embeddings throughput up 3x for bulk workloads. If we land these three initiatives, we hit the KR.
Jordan (Sales): That KR set maps well to pipeline asks. If we can show benchmarks and a customer-facing SLA, field traction will follow.
Maya Chen: Prioritization call: if tradeoffs needed, defer advanced rerank features (explainability UI) to Q1 and focus on stability + embeddings in Q4.
Alex P.: Agreed — action items: Isabella + Samir to estimate eng + infra effort (EOD tomorrow). Priya to prepare rerank test plan. Maya + Jordan to collect top 3 enterprise customer prompt sets. I'll consolidate into a one-pager and circulate for leadership.
deploy-bot: Deployment window reminder — scheduled maintenance on infra cluster tonight 23:00 UTC. Expect small traffic perturbations.
Isabella (Eng): Noted, we'll avoid large canaries during the maintenance window.
Alex P.: Thanks everyone — please add any blockers inline. We'll review estimates in tomorrow's PM sync. :thumbsup:
